messages:
marta (marketing): ran the inbound handoff stress test this morning after the webinar signups spike. attached perf graph in the drive. TL;DR: 2.5k leads/min burst => 30% enrichment delay, ~12% fallthrough to default owner.

sam (ops): whoa, 12% fallthrough is higher than we planned. did enrichment timeouts correlate with HB window? :thinking_face:

marta (marketing): yes — enrichment worker queue latency spiked at the same time. heartbeat logs show claim loop ran but enrichment TTL expired before enrichment webhook returned.

lucas (growth): can you paste the hubspot filter we used in the test? want to reproduce locally.

marta (marketing): here — HubSpot webhook payload filter we simulated:
```
properties: [email, lead_source, createdate, utm_campaign]
endpoint: /webhooks/inbound
retry_policy: exponential_backoff(3)
enrichment_timeout_ms: 800
```

aria (sales-ops): enrichment_timeout_ms 800ms is pretty strict for external enrichment during a burst. production uses 1.5s. did you test 1.5s?

marta (marketing): yes — at 1.5s fallthrough dropped to ~4.5% but latency still increased. main issue: our round-robin assignment code marks claim as ready before enrichment completes, so fallback path kicks in if enrichment slow.

sam (ops): that's the race. code snippet from the claim worker that triggers fallback:
```
if (enrichment.done || now - claim.started > ENR_TTL) {
  assignToRoundRobin()
} else {
  waitForEnrichment()
}
```
We need a short-circuit: if enrichment is pending but worker queue backs up, hold assignment for X ms and route to warm-standby pool instead of default owner.

lucas (growth): warm-standby pool sounds good for webinars / campaigns. can we create a campaign flag to enable warm-standby for high-QPS flows?

aria (sales-ops): yes, add campaign.metadata.high_volume: true. rule in SF mapping can route high_volume leads to warm pool. sample Salesforce routing rule:
```
IF campaign.metadata.high_volume = true THEN owner = "warm-standby-pool"
ELSE normal_rr()
```

marta (marketing): proposed mitigations from test: 1) increase enrichment_timeout to 1.5s for webhook consumer during bursts, 2) add warm-standby routing flag + SF rule, 3) modify claim worker to delay fallback by 300ms when queue depth > 50 and prefer warm pool, 4) create playbook for campaign spikes.

sam (ops): action items for ops/dev: modify claim worker + add metrics for queue depth, add feature flag for warm-standby routing. I'll open a PR and tag infra oncall.

marta (marketing): ops, please also add a smoke-check canary: simulate 1k leads/min for 2m with warm-standby enabled and verify fallthrough < 2%.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by sam with tag: inbound-rr-warmpool-2026-03. staging rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% (canary windows: 15m).

lucas (growth): ETA for PR? we want this before next big webinar next week.

sam (ops): PR by EOD today, staging canary tomorrow morning. will ping when staging metrics look good. :thumbsup:

aria (sales-ops): I'll draft the SF rule and update the campaign template docs. thanks team.

marta (marketing): great — thanks everyone. logging the test notes + graphs in the campaign runbook folder. followups: dashboard widget for fallthrough rate and enrichment latency per campaign.
